text: The Avengers were first formed in 1963 to stop Thor's adoptive brother Loki. Name the original five founding members from Avengers #1.
answer: Iron Man, Thor, Hulk, Ant-Man (Hank Pym), and Wasp (Janet van Dyne). [Captain America joined in #4!]
hint: Cap was still taking a 20-year ice nap! Think a green rage monster, a thunder god, a metal suit, and two bug-themed scientists.

text: In the Earth-838 universe depicted in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, who leads the Illuminati as the smartest man alive, and who portrays him in a cameo role?
answer: Reed Richards / Mister Fantastic, portrayed by John Krasinski.
hint: He really stretched his career far beyond Dunder Mifflin's paper company, only to get shredded like string cheese by Wanda!

text: What telepathic mutant cerebro-interface system was constructed by Charles Xavier beneath the Xavier School for Gifted Youngsters in Westchester, New York?
hint: It literally translates from Spanish to 'brain'. Chuck gets a massive migraine whenever someone leaves it on standby.

text: Which mutant telepath and psychic energy-wielding ninja swaps bodies with Betsy Braddock, later leading the covert mutant hit squad X-Force?
hint: She turns mental focus into a glowing purple butterfly knife—talk about having sharp thoughts!

text: Norrin Radd sacrificed his freedom to save his home planet Zenn-La, becoming the herald of the World Devourer. By what moniker is he known across the cosmos?
hint: Catching solar flares on a celestial surfboard while looking like a shiny chrome hood ornament for a hungry planet.

text: What cosmic weapon—forged in the heart of a dying neutron star by Eitri the Dwarf King on Nidavellir—was wielded by Thor to replace Mjolnir during the Infinity War?
hint: Part hammer, part battleaxe, with Groot's severed arm for a handle. It really knows how to break up a bad weather forecast!

text: In Hell's Kitchen, blinded by radioactive isotopes as a boy, Matt Murdock learned martial arts under the blind master of the Chaste. What is this master's name?
hint: You don't need 20/20 vision to guess this! His name comes from a branch of a tree, and he loves giving students a splintery thrashing.

text: Marc Spector was resurrected at the feet of an Egyptian moon deity after being left for dead in the Sudanese desert. Name this deity.
hint: He wears a giant skeletal bird skull for a head, loves glowing white capes, and won't stop nagging Marc to seek bloody vengeance.

text: Before turning Hydra infiltrators into bruised elevator wall décor in 'Captain America: The Winter Soldier', Steve Rogers politely asked if anyone wanted to get out. Five years later in 'Avengers: Endgame', Steve boarded the exact same elevator with Jasper Sitwell and Brock Rumlow, but bypassed the brawl entirely by leaning in and whispering what scandalous two-word greeting?
hint: Two words that would make Red Skull shed a single tear of joy, referencing a 2016 comic cliffhanger that broke the entire comic book internet.

text: In 'Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness', Earth-838's Illuminati tribunal claimed to possess the smartest intellects across the cosmos. Which hero—introduced as the leader of the Fantastic Four and played by John Krasinski—famously bragged that Black Bolt could destroy Wanda Maximoff with a whisper, only to be promptly shredded into biological string cheese?
hint: He was billed as the smartest man alive until he gave away his best teammate's tactical weakness in five seconds flat, ending up turned into Italian pasta.
